tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground of this system's own pages and covers. Video grounds use the palette colours.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text on `ground`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground`; 13px and up.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Lead colour. Ground of `sol`, rays of `lima` and `mango`, paint of `selva`, `noche` and `rosa`. Address letters on an `ink` strip.

tokens.name: jungle
tokens.usage: Lead colour. Ground of `selva`, leaves of `sol`, `noche` and `lima`. `ink` type reads on it at 6:1.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Ground of `lima`, leaves of `selva`, `sol` and `noche`. `ink` type reads on it.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Rays of `selva` and `noche`, leaves of `sol`, `lima` and `mango`.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Ground of `noche`, dark leaves, hard shadows on a dark scene. The only dark ground.

tokens.name: mango
tokens.usage: Minority ground (`mango` palette), rays of `sol`, a genre strip. `ink` type reads on it.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Accent only: `picado` flags and confetti.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Paint of `sol`, `lima` and `mango`, handle strip, minority ground (`rosa`). `cream` type on it at large sizes only (3.4:1).

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Rays of `rosa` only.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Accent only: a genre strip, `picado` flags and confetti. Never a ground.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Accent only, as it occurs in the congas. Never a ground.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Die-cut border of stickers, handle letters on a `pink` strip, relief tile.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Type on `sun`, `lime`, `mango` and `jungle`, address strip, hard shadows.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Used only for words the sheet has no lettering for. Sizes are render sizes at a 1080-wide frame; the PNG is then scaled to its slot.

styles.name: display-tile
styles.usage: A new word in the hand-lettered voice, with a dry-brush knock-out of 0.25.

groups.name: Information
groups.note: Barlow Condensed Black Italic, uppercase, on a brush strip.

styles.name: info-line
styles.usage: Address and handle. `sun` on an `ink` strip, `cream` on a `pink` strip. The PNG is scaled to the strip width.

spacing.note: Steps for this system's own pages. Video layouts are placed as fractions of the frame.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a name and its tagline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gutter in a page or a band of blocks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Page inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Pitch of the chevron pattern in the aguayo band.

radius.note: No rounded corners. Round forms come from the artwork.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tiles, bands and blocks.

shadow.note: Offset only, no blur. Values at a 1080-wide frame; recolour to `deep` on a dark scene.

tokens.name: hard-s
tokens.usage: Icons and small flowers.

tokens.name: hard-m
tokens.usage: Chips and genre strips.

tokens.name: hard-l
tokens.usage: Subject stickers.

tokens.name: hard-xl
tokens.usage: The largest lettering.

timing.note: Video timing. All clips cut to one grid.

tokens.name: bpm
tokens.usage: Tempo of every cut and of the library track chosen for it.

tokens.name: fps
tokens.usage: Master frame rate.

tokens.name: beat-frames
tokens.usage: Frames per beat.

tokens.name: bar-frames
tokens.usage: Frames per bar. Scene changes land here.

tokens.name: step-frames
tokens.usage: Frames each pose is held: animation on twos.

tokens.name: boil-fps
tokens.usage: Rate at which the edge displacement changes its seed.

tokens.name: grit-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of `Textures/grit_knockout.png` over the frame.

tokens.name: frame-9x16
tokens.usage: Reels, Shorts, TikTok. Published first.

tokens.name: frame-1x1
tokens.usage: Feed posts. Square layouts.

tokens.name: frame-4x5
tokens.usage: Feed posts. Uses the square layouts.

tokens.name: frame-16x9
tokens.usage: YouTube, venue screens. Landscape layouts.
